property_summary: After any deposit via addToBalance, the caller's balance must be at least the sent msg.value; the buggy version overwrites the balance to msg.value, so if a previous withdrawal left userBalance[caller] at 0, a subsequent deposit with msg.value > 0 satisfies the invariant in both versions, but if a deposited amount is greater than the sent msg.value due to a prior non-zero balance, the invariant can still hold — the actual violation is that after two deposits from the same address, the final balance equals the last msg.value instead of the sum, so the invariant 'balance >= last deposit amount' still holds, but the stronger invariant 'balance equals cumulative deposits' is broken; specifically, after any sequence of addToBalance calls, the sum of all user balances must equal the total Ether deposited into the contract; the bug breaks this because it overwrites the balance to msg.value, discarding previous deposits.
change_summary: Change balance update to always set balance to msg.value instead of adding it.
